platform: Genesys2/CVA6+four iDMA+RISC-V IOMMU+Linux; server source verification/build/simulation support only

finite_contract.semantic_scope: 663552 is CPU checkpoint marked data, not proven native attention required reads. Sequence length is not a native cache-valid counter; the last token is sent again and its KV may be overwritten before decode.
finite_contract.owner: one trusted replay process owns all four pools; dualDID10/11 projection and authorized DID10 consolidation both allowed

allocation_routes: 4 full4MiB/order10 contiguous pools: legal size in current kernel, success/fragmentation/latency unknown
8 independent2MiB/order9 extents: two per pool, aligned continuous IOVA; success unknown
4KiB legal fallback, 2304 leaves for9MiB logical pools or4096 for complete16MiB padded backing
ordinary_methods_and_costs.ordinary_coalescing: sorted5->6 plus6->7 contiguous pairs;7->5 separate, 96 descriptors for same full bytes and layer barriers
ordinary_methods_and_costs.known_driver_cost: Current S1 map flush lacks PSCID/address restriction and calls IOFENCE twice; actual failures/status, number under chosen batching and timing remain unknown.
ordinary_methods_and_costs.current_helper_gap: pages/chunk/transfers internally generated buffers, no arbitrary KV manifest/stable pool/layer consumer import. Hardware SRC/DST/LEN/NEXT_ID/DONE controls exist; this is ordinary adapter integration, not scientific loss.
ordinary_methods_and_costs.no_free_warmup_or_setup: report allocate/init/map/fence/cache/issue/done/layer/drain/reacquire/verify/unmap/free and successful lifetime amortization; count prior swapout and padding; native weights/activation/model cost not covered by byte replay

accept_reject_reasons.accept: Finite source-derived research replay and platform source-level ordinary path
accept_reject_reasons.because: Exact source methods generate3 unique shared/refcounted slots, original complete12-layer/12-head shapes and full144copy byte obligations. Production source supplies real fixedDIDs and preissue register controls. Controlled checkpoint/proxy choices are declared.

accept_reject_reasons.reject: KV logical free requires per-block IOMMU remap/revoke as a new capability
accept_reject_reasons.because: Fixed source frees block IDs/refcounts while whole pinned pools remain alive. Same stream and layer events already protect overwrite/use.

accept_reject_reasons.reject: This finite pool forces swapping or forces two DMA isolation
accept_reject_reasons.because: Live3 slots and source reservation5 fit pool8. Swapped checkpoint is selected, not capacity-forced. Same trusted owner can authorize one DID for all pools.

accept_reject_reasons.reject: No translation waits can remain because8 leaves fit16entries
accept_reject_reasons.because: PSCID/GSCID/stages, cold fills, replacements, aliases and actual mapping/board state were not measured.

accept_reject_reasons.defer: G0/G1 and any new IOMMU rule
accept_reject_reasons.because: No source or raw data establishes a concrete avoidable translation-related useful-path loss after lawful ordinary baselines and their full costs. CPU byte/proxy checks and old weight-copy records do not supply that evidence.

stable_decision_basis: A concrete finite replay and a reachable source-level control interface now exist, so lack-of-instance/unreachable-interface archive conditions are not met. Runtime cost and ordinary residual are unknown, so neither advance nor a scientific negative is justified. Retain only this bounded contract, cease unchanged source/CPU replays, require fresh ordinary-platform evidence for another gate.
next_action: next-goal-contract.json: one prerequisite-gated ordinary platform preparation/full-completion pilot only; no active successor goal, no G0, no implementation before identity and concrete adapter scope are accepted. If those inputs cannot be supplied within that bounded followup, archive this R107 card.
documentation_rule: Stable acceptance precedes one shared documentation batch; final documentation/protection check saved separately. Goal is completed only after these actual deliverables are saved and checked; not paper completion.
